title: Kagamine Len — Cheers ☆ For ☆ You!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Listen up, everyone! That includes all of you participating in this contest, and all of you guys in the audience!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The SEKAI Acting Contest, the Len & Emu Cup, will begin momentarily!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: First, allow me to explain the rules for this contest. Each category will have its own script, and you'll be tasked with reciting lines from it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can't go changing the lines entirely, but you can adjust them a little if you want to!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! Which means ad-libbing is allowed!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Next, we have our judges.
KAITO and the others will each score contestants based on a ten-point scale.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you for doing this, KAITO!
And you guys for agreeing to help him, Tsukasa, Nene, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course we agreed to help.
You didn't honestly think we'd pass up such a fun event, did you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, the scripts you guys picked for these categories all seemed really good.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think we're all looking forward to seeing everyone's performances.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's get this contest started!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Our first category is... “Cuteness”!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
“Pretty please with sugar on top!
Just one... That's okay, right☆”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They've definitely all come up with plans as to how they're going to capture everyone's hearts with their cuteness.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, despite each performance only being a few lines long, they were all very compelling. Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Entry number seven! Kagamine Len!
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
“Pretty please with sugar on top!
Just one is okay, right☆”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I liked the way he paused for a second there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he used his eyes very well there just now. If he acted that way in front of me, I'd probably give him all the cookies instead of just one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“What...? Of course I have a conscience.
I am human, after all.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“But all is fair in love and war.
If it means getting that man to notice me, then I am willing to do anything.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The story of a female spy who is willing to resort to any means in order to complete her mission, for the one she loves. What a bewitching performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, MEIKO really knows how to look and act beautiful. What did you think, Rui—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Entry number X. Rui Kamishiro.
Thank you for having me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Of course I have a conscience.
Even... Even I am human, after all!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“But all is fair in love and war!
If it means getting that man to notice me...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
No fair, Rui! I want to be in this contest too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “It's not that I'm too strong to give up.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “It's because heroes aren't supposed to give up.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Interesting. She chose to shine a light on how heroes can feel very lonely at times, because they can't afford to show any weakness.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and the way she presented her character's resolve to keep being a hero was very cool. She definitely deserves some points for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Entry number X2! Tsukasa Tenma! Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you all for participating in the SEKAI Acting Contest! I really learned a lot watching your performances!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for doing this for us, Len, Emu☆
That was really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, congratulations on winning the Cuteness and Coolness categories.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You also put on a stellar performance, Tsukasa. And you were so close. Just one point behind Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I already had a rough idea of how I'd play that character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I certainly would've worked on it more if I knew that we were allowed to jump in at the last minute.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You also came close in the Elegance category, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I couldn't quite match MEIKO's performance, but it was nice to be able to apply what I've learned at Morinomiya about playing a female character.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Kikyogumi may consist of only boys, but you still play female characters.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Congratulations again to the both of you, Len, Emu! Bravo!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for helping us out with this, KAITO!
We never would've been able to compete in it ourselves if you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And thanks again for agreeing to do this with me, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking you!
I was able to learn so many new things about acting because of you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And it's two birds with one stone in my case, since I got to run an actual contest☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, Len, thank you very much!
